title: Ultimate Puff Custard Purple Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Purple Custard from Ultimate Puff’s range of 100ml shortfills is a deliciously sweet and jammy Grape Bubblegum syrup swirled into rich Vanilla Custard. Smooth, sweet and utterly moreish, this unusually decadent dessert vape has to be vaped to be believed. These premium shortfill bottles contain 100ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 20ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create an e-liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill will give you 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well to combine. Ultimate Juice is a UK e-liquid company with an ever-expanding range of astonishing e-liquid flavours that run the gamut from juicy fruits to mouth-watering candy, decadent desserts, refreshing menthols and many more. With well over 300 juices currently in circulation, their premium e-juices are designed to give you a wealth of options when it comes to your all-day vape. E-liquid in Shortfills are a great way to make your favourite e-liquid last longer, saving you money and trips online and to your local Vapestore to resupply. These e-liquids tend to be high in VG (vegetable glycerin) and are best suited to high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits with low-resistance coils to achieve the best flavour and vapour production from your e-liquid.
